course.title: Khaemenes Higher Learning Introduction to Proofs
course.audience: Advanced undergraduates, independent learners, and prospective graduate students preparing for proof-based mathematics and research.
course.prerequisite: Algebra fluency and willingness to read and write mathematical arguments. Calculus or Discrete Mathematics is recommended but not required.
course.credit_guidance: Designed as an advanced transition-to-proof course. It prepares learners for upper-level and graduate-preparatory mathematics but does not claim to be a graduate core course.
